old_caption: In the video, a man is seated at a table in what appears to be a classroom or laboratory setting, indicated by the whiteboard in the background. He is wearing a green shirt over a white undershirt and has short dark hair and a beard. The man is engaged in an experiment involving a clear plastic bottle with a red cap, which he places into a metal pot sitting on a hot plate branded "Capitec." To his left, there is a large white bowl filled with water. Throughout the video, the man gestures with his hands while explaining or demonstrating something related to the experiment. His right hand frequently moves to adjust the bottle's position in the pot, while his left hand remains relatively still, occasionally gesturing for emphasis. The lighting is consistent, suggesting an indoor environment with artificial light. There are no other significant objects or characters visible in the scene, focusing attention solely on the man and his actions with the bottle and hot plate.

caption: A man in a green shirt sits at a table before a whiteboard, holding a clear plastic bottle upright in a metal pot of water that rests on a small electric hot plate. A pink balloon is stretched over the bottle's mouth, and his right hand steadies the bottle neck while his left hand pinches the loose top of the balloon. For the first part of the clip the balloon hangs limp and deflated to one side. As he talks, the balloon body gradually swells into a rounded, inflated shape protruding from the bottle opening. His left hand then releases the balloon and lifts into an open-palm gesture, moving outward beside him. The right hand continues to grip the bottle, keeping it standing in the pot of water. A white bowl of water sits untouched on the table to his right throughout the scene.
